# Sammy Javed

> Personal website of Sammy Javed — a software developer living in the SF Bay Area. This site shares projects, writing, and personal interests (travel, books, movies, photography, music, and more).

## About

Sammy Javed is a software engineer based in the San Francisco Bay Area. This site is a personal portfolio and journal covering both professional work and hobbies.

## Pages

- [Homepage](https://sammyjaved.com/) — Landing page
- [Academic](https://sammyjaved.com/academic) — Academic work
- [Projects](https://sammyjaved.com/projects) — Software and side projects
- [Journal](https://sammyjaved.com/journal) — Personal writing

## Projects

- [ImageMorpher](https://sammyjaved.com/projects/image-morpher) — Face morphing API using dlib and Delaunay triangulation. Live at pyaar.ai/morph with a React Native iOS client.
- [My Personal Website](https://sammyjaved.com/projects/my-personal-website) — This site. React 16 + styled-components, deployed via Docker and nginx on Linode.
- [Pyaar AI](https://pyaar.ai) — Music transcription API that converts audio to MIDI using a PyTorch rewrite of Google's MT3 model.
